_doc: Minor Hotels P1 new-market registration seeds (Sunshine Coast AU + Mozambique). Tasklet seeds candidate city_markets + boarding points + route archetypes + country tags; Grok owns the deterministic gazetteer promotion + route seal. Status seal-needed. null beats confidently-wrong: unverified jetty coords are candidate, not asserted geometry.

new_markets.rationale: 3 beachfront Minor properties (Avani Mooloolaba + 2 Oaks) on the Sunshine Coast QLD; no existing Atlas market. Mooloolaba is a working marina/harbour town — turnkey water node. Pairs with the existing brisbane node ~90km south for a coastal shuttle.

anchor_minor_properties.note: On Mooloolaba Esplanade; Mooloolaba Harbour/marina adjacent.

anchor_minor_properties.note: Caloundra — Pumicestone Passage / Bulcock Beach waterfront.

route_archetypes: city→coast shuttle (Brisbane/Moreton Bay ↔ Sunshine Coast, replacing the Bruce Hwy run)

new_markets.rationale: 3 boat-native Minor properties — 2 private-island Anantaras (Bazaruto, Medjumbe) + Avani Pemba (Quirimbas gateway). Transfers are inherently water/air; highest captive-transfer fit of any P1 market. No existing Atlas market.

anchor_minor_properties.name: Anantara Bazaruto Island Resort
anchor_minor_properties.note: Island off Vilankulo; boat/air transfer native.

anchor_minor_properties.name: Avani Pemba Beach Hotel
anchor_minor_properties.note: Pemba Bay beachfront; mainland gateway hub to Quirimbas/Medjumbe.
